reason: Canonical text verified as Kulke, von Duhn, Schneider, and Rakoczy (2018), DOI 10.1177/0956797617747090. Page 6 reports three distinct one-sample t tests with Cohen's d for the Southgate et al. (2007)/Senju et al. (2009) paradigm in Study 1 (overall DLS d = 0.25, p = .083; False Belief 1 d = 0.95, p < .001; False Belief 2 d = -0.54, p = .015), and neutral locators do not uniquely identify which test this row targets; because the authors report that overall findings and False Belief 2 were not replicated whereas False Belief 1 was replicated, an effect-specific replication verdict cannot be assigned.
